verzen.tekst: Hear therefore, you kings, and understand.
verzen.html: Hear therefore, you kings, and understand.

verzen.tekst: Give ear, you rulers who have dominion over many people,
verzen.html: Give ear, you rulers who have dominion over many people,

verzen.tekst: because your dominion was given to you from the Lord,
verzen.html: because your dominion was given to you from the Lord,

verzen.tekst: because being officers of his kingdom, you didn’t judge rightly,
verzen.html: because being officers of his kingdom, you didn’t judge rightly,

verzen.tekst: He will come upon you awfully and swiftly,
verzen.html: He will come upon you awfully and swiftly,

verzen.tekst: For the man of low estate may be pardoned in mercy,
verzen.html: For the man of low estate may be pardoned in mercy,

verzen.tekst: For the Sovereign Lord of all will not be impressed with anyone,
verzen.html: For the Sovereign Lord of all will not be impressed with anyone,

verzen.tekst: but the scrutiny that comes upon the powerful is strict.
verzen.html: but the scrutiny that comes upon the powerful is strict.

verzen.tekst: Therefore, my words are to you, O princes,
verzen.html: Therefore, my words are to you, O princes,

verzen.tekst: For those who have kept the things that are holy in holiness will be made holy.
verzen.html: For those who have kept the things that are holy in holiness will be made holy.

verzen.tekst: Therefore set your desire on my words.
verzen.html: Therefore set your desire on my words.

verzen.tekst: Wisdom is radiant and doesn’t fade away;
verzen.html: Wisdom is radiant and doesn’t fade away;

verzen.tekst: She anticipates those who desire her, making herself known.
verzen.html: She anticipates those who desire her, making herself known.

verzen.tekst: He who rises up early to seek her won’t have difficulty,
verzen.html: He who rises up early to seek her won’t have difficulty,

verzen.tekst: For to think upon her is perfection of understanding,
verzen.html: For to think upon her is perfection of understanding,

verzen.tekst: because she herself goes around, seeking those who are worthy of her,
verzen.html: because she herself goes around, seeking those who are worthy of her,

verzen.tekst: For her true beginning is desire for instruction;
verzen.html: For her true beginning is desire for instruction;

verzen.tekst: And love is observance of her laws.
verzen.html: And love is observance of her laws.

verzen.tekst: Immortality brings closeness to God.
verzen.html: Immortality brings closeness to God.

verzen.tekst: So then desire for wisdom promotes to a kingdom.
verzen.html: So then desire for wisdom promotes to a kingdom.

verzen.tekst: If therefore you delight in thrones and sceptres, you princes of peoples,
verzen.html: If therefore you delight in thrones and sceptres, you princes of peoples,

verzen.tekst: But what wisdom is, and how she came into being, I will declare.
verzen.html: But what wisdom is, and how she came into being, I will declare.

verzen.tekst: Indeed, I won’t travel with consuming envy,
verzen.html: Indeed, I won’t travel with consuming envy,

verzen.tekst: But a multitude of wise men is salvation to the world,
verzen.html: But a multitude of wise men is salvation to the world,

verzen.tekst: Therefore be instructed by my words, and you will profit.
verzen.html: Therefore be instructed by my words, and you will profit.
